main_measure.name: mean of (next-day return - coin mean daily return) x position held, on non-zero positions

statistic.name: t of the mean (cases of one day summed)

main_measure.threshold: confirm: t >= 2 with supporting check > 0; reject: t <= -2; otherwise inconclusive; minimum 300 position days on 150 distinct days

supporting_check.name: top third minus bottom third of non-zero forecasts, drift-adjusted next-day return

decided_by: The main measure's t is 2 or more and the supporting check is above 0 (confirm rule).
reading: Agitated profile read as regime 'unknown' (the non-chop regime carrying the strategy) and the situation as a raw value above 0 there, long; positions are postRebalance_current_allocation != 0 with a next-day return in the same window, every bar counted (1-bar horizon), the t uses per-day sums of the products across coins, the coin mean is over all its windows' daily returns, and the thirds are floor(n/3) lowest and highest non-zero forecasts pooled over all coins; fewer cases than the plan's minimums is reported as 'not observable'.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.0009886 on the check folds against +0.001089 on every fold
